heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋卡片容器內三欄分隔網格＋跨邊按鈕
desc: 上方置中的標題組，下方一張橫跨頁面內容寬度的大卡片，裡面三欄等寬項目以直向分隔線隔開，一顆置中按鈕跨在卡片下緣上。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組；標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略；標題明顯大於下方文字。標題組下方是一張大卡片容器，寬度對齊頁面內容寬度，裡面是多個項目排成的網格，每列三個等寬、等高的項目，三欄靠上對齊，欄與欄之間有直向分隔線。每個項目無外框：最上方是一張小型方形圖片，明顯小於欄寬，下方依序是小標籤、標題（可多行）與說明文字；圖片、小標籤與標題水平置中，說明文字靠左對齊、整段在欄內置中；小標籤與說明文字可省略，沒有時省略。卡片容器下方置中放一個按鈕，跨在卡片容器的下緣上，約一半在卡片內、一半在卡片外。
mobile: 標題組仍在上方置中。卡片容器保留，項目改為直向堆疊，每列一個項目，項目之間的直向分隔線改為橫向分隔線；項目裡的圖片不顯示，小標籤、標題與說明文字全部改為靠左對齊。按鈕仍置中跨在卡片容器的下緣上。

en.name: Centered heading + three-column divided grid in a container card + straddling button
en.desc: A centered heading group above one large card spanning the page content width, holding three equal-width items separated by vertical dividers, with a centered button straddling the card's bottom edge.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content; the title is clearly larger than the text below it. Below the heading group is one large container card aligned to the page content width, holding a grid of multiple items with three equal-width, equal-height items per row; the three columns are top-aligned, with vertical dividers between columns. Each item has no frame: at the top is a small square image, clearly smaller than the column width, followed by a label, a title (may wrap to multiple lines) and a description; the image, label and title are centered horizontally, while the description is left-aligned with the paragraph as a whole centered in the column; the label and description are optional; omit them when there is no content. Below the container card, place a centered button straddling the card's bottom edge, about half inside the card and half outside.
en.mobile: The heading group stays at the top, centered. The container card remains; the items change to a vertical stack with one item per row, and the vertical dividers between columns become horizontal dividers between items; the images inside the items are hidden, and the label, title and description are all left-aligned. The button stays centered, straddling the bottom edge of the container card.
